rules.title: Source of Lawful Income Protection – Housing
rules.quote: The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination based on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses. This means, for example, that a landlord cannot deny the lawful recipient of a Section 8 HUD voucher the right to rent an apartment based solely on that source of lawful income.
rules.summary: Landlords cannot discriminate against tenants or purchasers based on their source of lawful income, including Section 8 vouchers.
rules.coverage_text: All property including open land, whether for business or residential purposes, with exceptions for certain owner-occupied dwellings and religious organization preferences.
rules.exemption_note: Exemptions include: rental of single apartment in two-family dwelling where owner occupies other unit; rental of rooms in one-family dwelling occupied by owner; religious organization preferences; housing for older persons (familial status protection only).
